# LOAD DATA 
```{r load_data}
set.seed(123)

counts  <- read.csv("Merged_Count.csv", row.names = 1, header = TRUE, check.names = FALSE)
coldata <- read.csv("ColData.csv", row.names = 1)
common  <- intersect(colnames(counts), rownames(coldata))
counts  <- counts[, common, drop = FALSE]
coldata <- coldata[common, , drop = FALSE]

# DESeqDataSet — filtered
dds0 <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = counts, colData = coldata, design = ~ 1)
dds0 <- dds0[rowSums(counts(dds0) >= 5) >= 3, ]

# Save background miRNA list for DIANA
miRNA_for_background <- rownames(dds0)
write.table(miRNA_for_background, file = "DIANA_background_miRNAs.txt",
            quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, col.names = FALSE)

# VST for PCA and expression plots
vsd <- varianceStabilizingTransformation(dds0, blind = TRUE)
count_mat <- assay(vsd)

# ---- Shared theme ----
jn_theme <- theme_classic(base_size = 10) +
  theme(
    axis.line        = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.4),
    axis.ticks       = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.4),
    axis.text        = element_text(color = "black", size = 9),
    axis.title       = element_text(size = 10),
    panel.grid       = element_blank(),
    panel.border     = element_blank(),
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text       = element_text(size = 9),
    legend.title     = element_text(size = 9),
    legend.text      = element_text(size = 8),
    plot.margin      = margin(4, 6, 4, 4)
  )
```

## Figure 5C,D — PCA Plot (PC1 vs PC2, labeled by Sample ID) ; Top 20 Most Expressed miRNAs (Mean VST-normalized expression)
```{r fig5C}
mat <- count_mat

# ---- Panel C: PCA ----
pca        <- prcomp(t(mat), center = TRUE, scale. = FALSE)
percentVar <- 100 * (pca$sdev^2) / sum(pca$sdev^2)

cat("Variance explained (%):\n")
print(round(percentVar[1:5], 2))

scores <- as.data.frame(pca$x[, 1:2]) %>%
  rownames_to_column("Sample")

p_pca <- ggplot(scores, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, label = Sample)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = Sample), size = 2.5, alpha = 0.9, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_text_repel(size = 2.5, max.overlaps = Inf, box.padding = 0.4,
                  point.padding = 0.3, min.segment.length = 0.2, color = "grey30") +
  labs(x = paste0("PC1 (", round(percentVar[1], 1), "% variance)"),
       y = paste0("PC2 (", round(percentVar[2], 1), "% variance)")) +
  jn_theme

ggsave("Figure_4C.tiff", plot = p_pca, device = "tiff", dpi = 300,
       width = 8, height = 8, units = "cm", compression = "lzw", bg = "white")

# ---- Panel D: Top 20 most expressed miRNAs ----
top20 <- mat %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("miRNA") %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(mean_vst = mean(c_across(where(is.numeric)))) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  slice_max(mean_vst, n = 20) %>%
  mutate(miRNA = fct_reorder(miRNA, mean_vst))

p_top20 <- ggplot(top20, aes(x = miRNA, y = mean_vst)) +
  geom_col(fill = "pink", color = NA, width = 0.7) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Mean VST-normalized expression") +
  jn_theme +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(face = "italic", size = 8))

ggsave("Figure_4D.tiff", plot = p_top20, device = "tiff", dpi = 300,
       width = 8, height = 9, units = "cm", compression = "lzw", bg = "white")
```

# FIGURE 6 — Correlation Analysis + Regression Plots: PC1 & PC2 vs SED60+ and MVPA30
```{r fig6}
# PCA (numerical) using VST + prcomp on top variable genes
library(DESeq2)
library(matrixStats)
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

set.seed(123)

# ---- 0. Load Data & Align ----
counts <- read.csv("Merged_Count.csv", row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)
coldata <- read.csv("ColData.csv", row.names = 1)
common <- intersect(colnames(counts), rownames(coldata))
counts <- counts[, common, drop = FALSE]
coldata <- coldata[common, , drop = FALSE]

# ---- 1. DESeqDataSet and Filter Low-count Features ----
dds0 <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = counts, colData = coldata, design = ~ 1)
keep <- rowSums(counts(dds0) >= 5) >= 3
dds0 <- dds0[keep, ]

# ---- 2. Variance Stabilizing Transformation (VST) ----
vsd <- varianceStabilizingTransformation(dds0, blind = TRUE)
mat <- assay(vsd)

# ---- 3. Select Top Variable Genes ----
n_top <- 500
rv <- rowVars(mat)
top_genes <- order(rv, decreasing = TRUE)[seq_len(min(n_top, length(rv)))]
mat_top <- mat[top_genes, , drop = FALSE]

# ---- 4. Perform PCA ----
pc <- prcomp(t(mat_top), center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)
percentVar <- 100 * (pc$sdev^2) / sum(pc$sdev^2)
pvar_df <- tibble(PC = paste0("PC", seq_along(percentVar)), PercentVariance = percentVar)

# Sample scores
scores <- as.data.frame(pc$x) %>%
  rownames_to_column("Sample") %>%
  left_join(rownames_to_column(as.data.frame(coldata), var = "Sample"), by = "Sample")

# Gene loadings
loadings <- as.data.frame(pc$rotation) %>%
  rownames_to_column("Feature")

# ---- 5. Save Outputs (Uncomment to save) ----
# write.csv(pvar_df, "PCA_percent_variance.csv", row.names = FALSE)
# write.csv(scores, "PCA_sample_scores.csv", row.names = FALSE)
# write.csv(loadings, "PCA_feature_loadings_topGenes.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# ---- 6. Correlation Analysis ----
run_correlation <- function(x, y, method = c("pearson", "spearman"), B = 5000, exact = FALSE) {
  method <- match.arg(method)
  complete_idx <- complete.cases(x, y)
  x <- x[complete_idx]
  y <- y[complete_idx]
  
  # Correlation test
  cor_res <- cor.test(x, y, method = method, exact = if (method == "spearman") exact else NULL)
  
  # Bootstrap
  boot_vals <- replicate(B, {
    idx <- sample(seq_along(x), replace = TRUE)
    cor(x[idx], y[idx], method = method)
  })
  
  boot_CI <- quantile(boot_vals, probs = c(0.025, 0.975))
  
  list(cor_test = cor_res, boot_CI = boot_CI, n = length(x))
}

# Run correlation analysis (Pearson & Spearman)
PCs <- c("PC1", "PC2")
predictor <- "sed60num_trimester1" # change this for each trimester or condition
B <- 5000

for (pc in PCs) {
  # Pearson correlation
  res_pearson <- run_correlation(scores[[pc]], coldata[[predictor]], method = "pearson", B = B)
  cat("\nPearson Correlation -", pc, "\n")
  print(res_pearson$cor_test)
  cat("Bootstrap 95% CI:\n")
  print(res_pearson$boot_CI)
  
  # Spearman correlation
  res_spearman <- run_correlation(scores[[pc]], coldata[[predictor]], method = "spearman", exact = TRUE, B = B)
  cat("\nSpearman Correlation -", pc, "\n")
  print(res_spearman$cor_test)
  cat("Bootstrap 95% CI:\n")
  print(res_spearman$boot_CI)
}

# ---- 8. Regression Plot ----
plot_df <- scores %>%
  mutate(
    Predictor = coldata[[predictor]],
    Quartile = factor(coldata$sed60num_quartile_postpartum)
  )

ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = Predictor, y = PC2, color = Quartile)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "black", se = TRUE) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Lower than or equal to 341.7" = "red", "Interquartile range" = "darkgreen", "Greater than or equal to 431.1" = "royalblue")) +
  labs(
    title = "PC2 vs. SED60+ (T4) by Quartile",
    x = "Minutes/day in moderate to sedentary bouts greater than or equal to 60 minutes",
    y = "PC2",
    color = "Quartile"
  ) +
  theme_classic()
```


# miRNA DIFFERENTIAL EXPRESSION — DESeq2
# Sedentary behavior (SED60+) and MVPA, all timepoints
```{r deseq2}
run_deseq <- function(coldata, counts, group_col, ref_level, contrast_levels,
                      output_file) {
  coldata_filt <- coldata %>%
    dplyr::select(all_of(group_col)) %>%
    filter(.data[[group_col]] != "Interquartile range") %>%
    mutate(Group = ifelse(grepl("Lower", .data[[group_col]]), "Low", "High")) %>%
    dplyr::select(Group)

  coldata_filt$Group <- factor(coldata_filt$Group, levels = c("Low", "High"))
  counts_filt        <- counts[, rownames(coldata_filt)]

  dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = counts_filt,
                                colData   = coldata_filt,
                                design    = ~ Group)
  dds <- estimateSizeFactors(dds)
  dds <- dds[rowSums(counts(dds, normalized = TRUE) >= 5) >= 3, ]
  dds$Group <- relevel(dds$Group, ref = ref_level)
  dds <- DESeq(dds)

  res <- results(dds, contrast = contrast_levels)
  degs <- na.omit(res[which(res$padj < 0.10), ])
  write.csv(as.data.frame(degs), output_file)
  return(res)
}

# ---- Sedentary behavior (SED60+) ----
results_activity_T1 <- run_deseq(coldata, counts,
  "sed60num_quartile_trimester1", "High", c("Group", "Low", "High"),
  "results_activity_T1_DEGs_NAomit.csv")

results_activity_T2 <- run_deseq(coldata, counts,
  "sed60num_quartile_trimester2", "High", c("Group", "Low", "High"),
  "results_activity_T2_DEGs_NAomit.csv")

results_activity_T3 <- run_deseq(coldata, counts,
  "sed60num_quartile_trimester3", "High", c("Group", "Low", "High"),
  "results_activity_T3_DEGs_NAomit.csv")

results_activity_PP <- run_deseq(coldata, counts,
  "sed60num_quartile_postpartum", "High", c("Group", "Low", "High"),
  "results_activity_PP_DEGs_NAomit.csv")
```

# ============================================================
# FIGURE 7 — Volcano Plots: SED60+ T1, T2, T3
# Note: Panels A–C generated individually; combined and lettered in PowerPoint
# ============================================================
```{r fig7}
make_volcano <- function(results_obj, title, subtitle, n_total, output_file) {
  df <- as.data.frame(results_obj)

  p <- EnhancedVolcano(
    df,
    lab          = rownames(df),
    x            = "log2FoldChange",
    y            = "padj",
    title        = title,
    subtitle     = subtitle,
    titleLabSize    = 16,
    subtitleLabSize = 13,
    pCutoff      = 0.054,
    FCcutoff     = 1.0,
    pointSize    = 2.0,
    labSize      = 5.0,
    colAlpha     = 0.6,
    selectLab    = rownames(df)[!is.na(df$padj) & df$padj < 0.054],
    drawConnectors  = TRUE,
    widthConnectors = 0.5,
    max.overlaps    = 50,
    legendPosition  = "right",
    legendLabels    = c("NS", "Log2FC", "P-value", "P-value + Log2FC"),
    col          = c("grey60", "#0072B2", "#CC79A7", "#009E73"),
    xlim         = c(-6, 6),
    ylim         = c(0, 3.5),
    caption      = paste0("total = ", n_total, " variables")
  ) +
    theme(
      axis.text  = element_text(size = 11),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 13)
    )

  ggsave(output_file, plot = p,
         width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300, compression = "lzw")
  return(p)
}

# Count total variables per timepoint (non-NA padj)
n_T1 <- sum(!is.na(as.data.frame(results_activity_T1)$padj))
n_T2 <- sum(!is.na(as.data.frame(results_activity_T2)$padj))
n_T3 <- sum(!is.na(as.data.frame(results_activity_T3)$padj))

fig7A <- make_volcano(results_activity_T1,
  title    = "Trimester One Prolonged Sedentary Behavior",
  subtitle = "Average minutes/day in sedentary bouts >=60 min, Q1 vs. Q3",
  n_total  = n_T1,
  output_file = "Figure_7A.tiff")

fig7B <- make_volcano(results_activity_T2,
  title    = "Trimester Two Prolonged Sedentary Behavior",
  subtitle = "Average minutes/day in sedentary bouts >=60 min, Q1 vs. Q3",
  n_total  = n_T2,
  output_file = "Figure_7B.tiff")

fig7C <- make_volcano(results_activity_T3,
  title    = "Trimester Three Prolonged Sedentary Behavior",
  subtitle = "Average minutes/day in sedentary bouts >=60 min, Q1 vs. Q3",
  n_total  = n_T3,
  output_file = "Figure_7C.tiff")
```
